description: This file defines the CandidateView class, which is a custom Android View for displaying suggested words (candidates) in an on-screen keyboard. It manages rendering suggestions, handling touch interactions, and highlighting selected candidates.

classes.name: CandidateView
classes.description: Custom View class for displaying candidate suggestions with interactive scrolling and touch handling.

methods.name: CandidateView
methods.description: Constructor initializing the view and its visual properties.

methods.name: setService
methods.description: Sets a reference to the SoftKeyboard service for callback communication.

methods.name: computeHorizontalScrollRange
methods.description: Returns the total scrollable width of suggestions.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures view size based on suggested text size and layout constraints.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Renders the suggestion words on the canvas, including selection highlights.

methods.name: scrollToTarget
methods.description: Smoothly scrolls to the target scroll position.

methods.name: setSuggestions
methods.description: Updates the list of suggestion words to display.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears suggestions and resets touch state.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch interactions for selecting suggestions.

methods.name: takeSuggestionAt
methods.description: Selects a suggestion based on a flick gesture at a given x coordinate.

methods.name: removeHighlight
methods.description: Removes the touch highlight from suggestions.
